facts.business: Hubtown Limited is a real estate developer with a focused presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), engaged in premium residential and commercial developments, rehabilitation and urban renewal projects, and public-private partnership (PPP) projects.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of interest expense amounting to ₹1,751.85 lakhs on certain inter-corporate deposits, leading to understatement of finance cost and overstatement of profit. Emphasis of matters include: recognition of project expenses based on management estimates, realizable value of project costs, corporate guarantees/securities of ₹81,240.01 lakhs not expected to result in financial liability, fair value measurement of financial guarantee contracts, reliance on management certification for contingent liabilities, balances subject to confirmation/reconciliation, non-charging of interest on advances to group entities, and investments in subsidiaries/JVs/associates with eroded net worth.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest expense on inter-corporate deposits
Reliance on management estimates for project cost recognition and realizable value
Significant corporate guarantees and securities provided (₹81,240.01 lakhs)
Non-measurement of financial guarantee contracts at fair value
Balances subject to confirmations, reconciliation and adjustments
Non-charging of interest on advances to group entities
Investments in subsidiaries/JVs/associates with eroded net worth
Regulatory and statutory approvals required for proposed mergers and amalgamations
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not charged interest on advances given to various group entities developing real estate projects in which the Company has a commercial and business interest (Footnote (a) to Note 9). Corporate guarantees issued and securities provided aggregating ₹81,240.01 lakhs by the Company to financial institutions on behalf of various entities (Note 38(i)(B)).
